035    /**
036     *
037     * @param ptLatLong
038     * @param converter
039     * @return
040     */
041    private static POINT2 PointLatLongToPixels(POINT2 ptLatLong,
042            IPointConversion converter) {
043        POINT2 pt = new POINT2();
044        try {
045            double x = ptLatLong.x;
046            double y = ptLatLong.y;
047            Point2D ptPixels = converter.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(x, y));
048            pt.x = ptPixels.getX();
049            pt.y = ptPixels.getY();
050            pt.style = ptLatLong.style;
051
052        } catch (Exception exc) {
053            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "PointLatLongToPixels",
054                    new RendererException("Failed inside PointLatLongToPixels", exc));
055        }
056        return pt;
057    }

059    /**
060     * for the change 1 fire support areas
061     *
062     * @param tg
063     * @param lineType
064     * @param radius
065     * @param width
066     * @param length
067     * @param attitude
068     */
069    private static void GetNumericFields(TGLight tg,
070            int lineType,
071            ref<double[]> radius,
072            ref<double[]> width,
073            ref<double[]> length,
074            ref<double[]> attitude) {
075        try {
076            if (lineType == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_FILL) {
077                return;
078            }
079            double dist = 0;
080            ref<double[]> a12 = new ref(), a21 = new ref();
081            POINT2 pt0 = new POINT2(0, 0);
082            POINT2 pt1 = new POINT2(0, 0);
083            radius.value = new double[1];
084            width.value = new double[1];
085            attitude.value = new double[1];
086            length.value = new double[1];
087            switch (lineType) {
088                case TacticalLines.CIRCULAR:
089                case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
090                case TacticalLines.FSA_CIRCULAR:
091                case TacticalLines.FFA_CIRCULAR:
092                case TacticalLines.NFA_CIRCULAR:
093                case TacticalLines.RFA_CIRCULAR:
094                case TacticalLines.PAA_CIRCULAR:
095                case TacticalLines.ATI_CIRCULAR:
096                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_CIRCULAR:
097                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_CIRCULAR:
098                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_CIRCULAR:
099                case TacticalLines.DA_CIRCULAR:
100                case TacticalLines.CFZ_CIRCULAR:
101                case TacticalLines.ZOR_CIRCULAR:
102                case TacticalLines.TBA_CIRCULAR:
103                case TacticalLines.TVAR_CIRCULAR:
104                case TacticalLines.ACA_CIRCULAR:
105                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_CIRCULAR:
106                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
107                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_T1())) {
108                        radius.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_T1());
109                    }
110                    break;
111                case TacticalLines.LAUNCH_AREA:
112                    //minor radius in meters
113                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_T1())) {
114                        length.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_T1());
115                    }
116                    //major radius in meters
117                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_H())) {
118                        width.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_H());
119                    }
120                    //rotation angle in degrees
121                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_H2())) {
122                        attitude.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_H2());
123                    }
124
125                    break;
126                case TacticalLines.RECTANGULAR:
127                case TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE:
128                case TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE:
129                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_T1())) {
130                    //if (!tg.get_T1().isEmpty()){
131                        length.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_T1());
132                    }
133                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_H())) {
134                    //if (!tg.get_H().isEmpty()){
135                        width.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_H());
136                    }
137                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_H1())) {
138                    //if (!tg.get_H1().isEmpty()){
139                        radius.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_H1());
140                    }
141                    //assume that attitude was passed in mils
142                    //so we must multiply by 360/6400 to convert to degrees                    
143                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_H2())) {
144                        //value passed in mils, convert mils to degrees
145                        attitude.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_H2()) * (360d / 6400d);
146                        //if(RendererSettings.getInstance().getSymbologyStandard()==RendererSettings.Symbology_2525C) //value passed in degrees
147                        if (tg.getSymbologyStandard() == RendererSettings.Symbology_2525C) //value passed in degrees
148                        {
149                            attitude.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_H2());
150                        }
151                    }
152                    break;
153                case TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR_REVC:
154                case TacticalLines.FSA_RECTANGULAR:
155                case TacticalLines.FFA_RECTANGULAR:
156                case TacticalLines.ACA_RECTANGULAR:
157                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
158                case TacticalLines.RFA_RECTANGULAR:
159                case TacticalLines.ATI_RECTANGULAR:
160                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_RECTANGULAR:
161                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
162                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
163                case TacticalLines.DA_RECTANGULAR:
164                case TacticalLines.CFZ_RECTANGULAR:
165                case TacticalLines.ZOR_RECTANGULAR:
166                case TacticalLines.TBA_RECTANGULAR:
167                case TacticalLines.TVAR_RECTANGULAR:
168                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
169                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
170                    if (tg.LatLongs.size() >= 2) {
171                        if (tg.LatLongs.size() >= 2) {
172                            //get the length and the attitude in mils
173                            pt0 = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
174                            pt1 = tg.LatLongs.get(1);
175                            dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(pt0, pt1, a12, a21);
176                            attitude.value[0] = a12.value[0];
177                        }
178                    }
179                    if (SymbolUtilities.isNumber(tg.get_T1())) {
180                        width.value[0] = Double.parseDouble(tg.get_T1());
181                    }
182                    break;
183                default:
184                    break;
185            }
186        } catch (Exception exc) {
187            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetNumericFields",
188                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetNumericFields", exc));
189        }
190    }

192    /**
193     * Do a 360 degree horizontal shift for points on either side of the
194     * midpoint of the display, if the MBR for the pixels is greater than 180
195     * degrees wide. Builds pixels for two symbols to draw a symbol flipped
196     * about the left edge and also a symbol flipped about the right edge. This
197     * function is typically used at world view. Caller must instantiate last
198     * two parameters.
199     *
200     * @param tg
201     * @param converter
202     * @param farLeftPixels - OUT - the resultant pixels for left shift symbol
203     * @param farRightPixels - OUT - the result pixels for the right shift
204     * symbol
205     */
206    protected static void GetFarPixels(TGLight tg,
207            IPointConversion converter,
208            ArrayList farLeftPixels,
209            ArrayList farRightPixels) {
210        try {
211            if (farLeftPixels == null || farRightPixels == null) {
212                return;
213            }
214            //Cannot use tg.LatLon to get width in degrees because it shifts +/-180 at IDL.
215            //Get degrees per pixel longitude, will use it for determining width in degrees
216            Point2D ptPixels50 = converter.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(50, 30));
217            Point2D ptPixels60 = converter.GeoToPixels(new Point2D.Double(60, 30));
218            double degLonPerPixel = 10 / Math.abs(ptPixels60.getX() - ptPixels50.getX());
219            int j = 0;
220            double minX = Double.MAX_VALUE, maxX = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
221            int n = tg.Pixels.size();
222            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
223            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
224                if (tg.Pixels.get(j).x < minX) {
225                    minX = tg.Pixels.get(j).x;
226                }
227                if (tg.Pixels.get(j).x > maxX) {
228                    maxX = tg.Pixels.get(j).x;
229                }
230            }
231            double degWidth = (maxX - minX) * degLonPerPixel;
232            if (Math.abs(degWidth) < 180) {
233                return;
234            }
235
236            //if it did not return then we must shift the pixels left and right
237            //first get the midpoint X value to use for partitioning the points
238            double midX = Math.abs(180 / degLonPerPixel);
239            double x = 0, y = 0;
240            //do a shift about the left hand side
241            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
242            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
243                x = tg.Pixels.get(j).x;
244                y = tg.Pixels.get(j).y;
245                if (x > midX) {
246                    //shift x left by 360 degrees in pixels
247                    x -= 2 * midX;
248                }
249                //else do not shift the point
250                //add the shifted (or not) point to the new arraylist
251                farLeftPixels.add(new POINT2(x, y));
252            }
253            //do a shift about the right hand side
254            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
255            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
256                x = tg.Pixels.get(j).x;
257                y = tg.Pixels.get(j).y;
258                if (x < midX) {
259                    //shift x right by 360 degrees in pixels
260                    x += 2 * midX;
261                }
262                //else do not shift the point
263                //add the shifted (or not) point to the new arraylist
264                farRightPixels.add(new POINT2(x, y));
265            }
266        } catch (Exception exc) {
267            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetFarPixels",
268                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetFarPixels", exc));
269        }
270    }

272    /**
273     *
274     * @param tg
275     * @param lineType
276     * @param converter
277     * @param shapes
278     * @return
279     */
280    protected static boolean Change1TacticalAreas(TGLight tg,
281            int lineType, IPointConversion converter, ArrayList<Shape2> shapes) {
282        try {
283            ref<double[]> width = new ref(), length = new ref(), attitude = new ref(), radius = new ref();
284            int j = 0;
285            POINT2 pt0 = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
286            POINT2 pt1 = null;
287            POINT2 ptTemp = new POINT2();
288            POINT2 pt00 = new POINT2();
289            if (tg.LatLongs.size() > 1) {
290                pt1 = tg.LatLongs.get(1);
291            } else {
292                pt1 = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
293            }
294            POINT2[] pPoints = null;
295            POINT2 ptCenter = PointLatLongToPixels(pt0, converter);
296
297            GetNumericFields(tg, lineType, radius, width, length, attitude);
298            switch (lineType) {
299                case TacticalLines.LAUNCH_AREA:
300                    POINT2[] ellipsePts = mdlGeodesic.getGeoEllipse(pt0, width.value[0], length.value[0], attitude.value[0]);
301                    for (j = 0; j < ellipsePts.length; j++) //was 103
302                    {
303                        pt0 = ellipsePts[j];
304                        pt1 = PointLatLongToPixels(pt0, converter);
305                        tg.Pixels.add(pt1);
306                    }
307                    break;
308                case TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR_REVC:
309                case TacticalLines.FSA_RECTANGULAR:
310                case TacticalLines.FFA_RECTANGULAR:
311                case TacticalLines.ACA_RECTANGULAR:
312                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
313                case TacticalLines.RFA_RECTANGULAR:
314                case TacticalLines.ATI_RECTANGULAR:
315                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_RECTANGULAR:
316                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
317                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
318                case TacticalLines.DA_RECTANGULAR:
319                case TacticalLines.CFZ_RECTANGULAR:
320                case TacticalLines.ZOR_RECTANGULAR:
321                case TacticalLines.TBA_RECTANGULAR:
322                case TacticalLines.TVAR_RECTANGULAR:
323                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
324                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
325                    //get the upper left corner                    
326                    pt00 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] - 90);
327                    pt00 = PointLatLongToPixels(pt00, converter);
328
329                    pt00.style = 0;
330                    tg.Pixels.add(pt00);
331
332                    //second corner (clockwise from center)
333                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 90);
334                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
335                    ptTemp.style = 0;
336                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
337
338                    //third corner (clockwise from center)
339                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt1, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 90);
340                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
341                    ptTemp.style = 0;
342                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
343
344                    //fouth corner (clockwise from center)
345                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt1, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] - 90);
346                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
347                    ptTemp.style = 0;
348                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
349
350                    tg.Pixels.add(pt00);
351                    break;
352                case TacticalLines.RECTANGULAR:
353                case TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE:
354                case TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE:
355                    //AFATDS swap length and width
356                    //comment next three lines to render per Mil-Std-2525
357                    //double temp=width.value[0];
358                    //width.value[0]=length.value[0];
359                    //length.value[0]=temp;
360
361                    //get the upper left corner
362                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, length.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] - 90);//was length was -90
363                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptTemp, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 0);//was width was 0
364
365                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
366                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
367                    //second corner (clockwise from center)
368                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, length.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 90);  //was length was +90
369                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptTemp, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 0);   //was width was 0
370
371                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
372
373                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
374
375                    //third corner (clockwise from center)
376                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, length.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 90);//was length was +90
377                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptTemp, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 180);//was width was +180
378
379                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
380
381                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
382
383                    //fouth corner (clockwise from center)
384                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, length.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] - 90);//was length was -90
385                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptTemp, width.value[0] / 2, attitude.value[0] + 180);//was width was +180
386
387                    ptTemp = PointLatLongToPixels(ptTemp, converter);
388                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp);
389                    tg.Pixels.add(new POINT2(tg.Pixels.get(0).x, tg.Pixels.get(0).y));
390                    break;
391                case TacticalLines.CIRCULAR:
392                case TacticalLines.BBS_POINT:
393                case TacticalLines.FSA_CIRCULAR:
394                case TacticalLines.ACA_CIRCULAR:
395                case TacticalLines.FFA_CIRCULAR:
396                case TacticalLines.NFA_CIRCULAR:
397                case TacticalLines.RFA_CIRCULAR:
398                case TacticalLines.PAA_CIRCULAR:
399                case TacticalLines.ATI_CIRCULAR:
400                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_CIRCULAR:
401                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_CIRCULAR:
402                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_CIRCULAR:
403                case TacticalLines.DA_CIRCULAR:
404                case TacticalLines.CFZ_CIRCULAR:
405                case TacticalLines.ZOR_CIRCULAR:
406                case TacticalLines.TBA_CIRCULAR:
407                case TacticalLines.TVAR_CIRCULAR:
408                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_CIRCULAR:
409                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_CIRCULAR:
410                    //get a horizontal point on the radius
411                    pt0 = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
412
413                    ptTemp = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, radius.value[0], 90);
414
415                    pPoints = new POINT2[3];
416                    pPoints[0] = new POINT2(pt0);
417                    pPoints[1] = new POINT2(ptTemp);
418                    pPoints[2] = new POINT2(ptTemp);
419
420                    ArrayList<POINT2> pPoints2 = mdlGeodesic.GetGeodesicArc(pPoints);
421                    POINT2 ptTemp2 = null;
422                    //fill pixels and latlongs
423                    for (j = 0; j < pPoints2.size(); j++) //was 103
424                    {
425                        pt0 = pPoints2.get(j);
426                        ptTemp2 = new POINT2();
427                        ptTemp2 = PointLatLongToPixels(pt0, converter);
428
429                        tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp2);
430                    }
431                    break;
432                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN:
433                    //get the concentric circles
434                    GetConcentricCircles(tg, lineType, converter);
435                    //Mil-Std-2525 Rev C does not have the orientation arrow
436                    //assume we are using Rev C if there is only 1 anchor point
437                    if (tg.LatLongs.size() > 1) {
438                        RangeFanOrientation(tg, lineType, converter);
439                    }
440                    break;
441                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_SECTOR:
442                    GetSectorRangeFan(tg, converter);
443                    RangeFanOrientation(tg, lineType, converter);
444                    break;
445                case TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_FILL:  //circular range fan calls Change1TacticalAreas twice
446                    GetSectorRangeFan(tg, converter);
447                    break;
448                default:
449                    return false;
450            }
451
452            //the shapes
453            ArrayList<POINT2> farLeftPixels = new ArrayList();
454            ArrayList<POINT2> farRightPixels = new ArrayList();
455            clsUtilityCPOF.GetFarPixels(tg, converter, farLeftPixels, farRightPixels);
456            ArrayList<Shape2> shapesLeft = new ArrayList();
457            ArrayList<Shape2> shapesRight = new ArrayList();
458            //ArrayList<Shape2>shapes=null;   //use this to collect all the shapes
459
460            if (farLeftPixels.isEmpty() || farRightPixels.isEmpty()) {
461                //diagnostic
462                //Change1PixelsToShapes(tg,shapes);
463                ArrayList<POINT2> tempPixels = new ArrayList();
464                tempPixels.addAll((ArrayList) tg.Pixels);
465                clsUtilityCPOF.postSegmentFSA(tg, converter);
466                Change1PixelsToShapes(tg, shapes, false);
467                //reuse the original pixels for the subsequent call to AddModifier2
468                tg.Pixels = tempPixels;
469                //end section
470            } else //symbol was more than 180 degrees wide, use left and right symbols
471            {
472                //set tg.Pixels to the left shapes for the call to Change1PixelsToShapes
473                tg.Pixels = farLeftPixels;
474                Change1PixelsToShapes(tg, shapesLeft, false);
475                //set tg.Pixels to the right shapes for the call to Change1PixelsToShapes
476                tg.Pixels = farRightPixels;
477                Change1PixelsToShapes(tg, shapesRight, false);
478                //load left and right shapes into shapes
479                shapes.addAll(shapesLeft);
480                shapes.addAll(shapesRight);
481            }
482            if (lineType == TacticalLines.BBS_POINT) {
483                Shape2 shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
484                shape.moveTo(ptCenter);
485                //ptCenter.x+=1;
486                ptCenter.y += 1;
487                shape.lineTo(ptCenter);
488                shapes.add(shape);
489            }
490            if (lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_RECTANGLE || lineType == TacticalLines.PBS_SQUARE) 
491            {
492                double dist = radius.value[0];//Double.parseDouble(strH1);
493                pt0 = new POINT2(tg.LatLongs.get(0));
494                pt1 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, dist, 45);//45 is arbitrary
495                Point2D pt02d = new Point2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y);
496                Point2D pt12d = new Point2D.Double(pt1.x, pt1.y);
497                pt02d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt02d);
498                pt12d = converter.GeoToPixels(pt12d);
499                pt0.x = pt02d.getX();
500                pt0.y = pt02d.getY();
501                pt1.x = pt12d.getX();
502                pt1.y = pt12d.getY();
503                dist = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);    //pixels distance
504                //tg.Pixels.get(0).style=(int)dist;
505                ArrayList<POINT2> tempPixels = new ArrayList();
506                tempPixels.addAll((ArrayList) tg.Pixels);
507                POINT2[]pts=tempPixels.toArray(new POINT2[tempPixels.size()]);
508                pts[0].style=(int)dist;
509                lineutility.getExteriorPoints(pts, pts.length, lineType, false);
510                tg.Pixels.clear();
511                for(j=0;j<pts.length;j++)
512                    tg.Pixels.add(new POINT2(pts[j].x,pts[j].y));
513
514                Change1PixelsToShapes(tg, shapes, true);
515                //reuse the original pixels for the subsequent call to AddModifier2
516                tg.Pixels = tempPixels;                
517            }
518            return true;
519        } catch (Exception exc) {
520            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "Change1TacticalAreas",
521                    new RendererException("Failed inside Change1TacticalAreas", exc));
522        }
523        return false;
524    }

526    /**
527     * build shapes arraylist from tg.Pixels for the Change 1 symbols
528     *
529     * @param tg
530     * @param shapes - OUT - caller instantiates the arraylist
531     */
532    private static void Change1PixelsToShapes(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2> shapes, boolean fill) {
533        Shape2 shape = null;
534        boolean beginLine = true;
535        POINT2 currentPt = null, lastPt = null;
536        int k = 0;
537        int linetype = tg.get_LineType();
538        int n = tg.Pixels.size();
539            //a loop for the outline shapes            
540        //for (k = 0; k < tg.Pixels.size(); k++)
541        for (k = 0; k < n; k++) {
542            //use shapes instead of pixels
543            if (shape == null) {
544                //shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
545                if(!fill)
546                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
547                else if(fill)
548                    shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
549            }
550
551            currentPt = tg.Pixels.get(k);
552            if (k > 0) {
553                lastPt = tg.Pixels.get(k - 1);
554            }
555
556            if (beginLine) {
557                if (k == 0) {
558                    shape.set_Style(currentPt.style);
559                }
560
561                if (k > 0) //doubled points with linestyle=5
562                {
563                    if (currentPt.style == 5 && lastPt.style == 5) {
564                        shape.lineTo(currentPt);
565                    }
566                }
567
568                shape.moveTo(currentPt);
569                beginLine = false;
570            } else {
571                shape.lineTo(currentPt);
572                if (currentPt.style == 5 || currentPt.style == 10) {
573                    beginLine = true;
574                    //unless there are doubled points with style=5
575                    if (linetype == TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_FILL && k < tg.Pixels.size() - 1) {
576                        shapes.add(shape);
577                        shape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
578                    }
579                }
580            }
581            if (k == tg.Pixels.size() - 1) //PBS shapes have 2 shapes, other non-LC symbols have 1 shape
582            {
583                //shapes.add(shape);
584                if(shape.getShapeType()==ShapeInfo.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL)
585                    shapes.add(0,shape);
586                else
587                    shapes.add(shape);
588            }
589        }   //end for
590
591    }

593    private static void GetConcentricCircles(TGLight tg, int lineType, IPointConversion converter) {
594        try {
595            int j = 0, l = 0;
596            double radius = 0;
597
598            POINT2 pt = new POINT2();
599            ArrayList<POINT2> pts = new ArrayList();
600            double[] radii = null;
601            String H2 = tg.get_H2();
602            if (tg.LatLongs.size() == 1 && H2 != null)//client is using AM for the radii and is working to Mil-Std-2525 rev C
603            {
604                String[] strs = H2.split(",");
605                radii = new double[strs.length];
606                for (j = 0; j < strs.length; j++) {
607                    radii[j] = Double.parseDouble(strs[j]);
608                }
609            }
610            //if radii is null at this point then the client used points
611            //and is working to Mil-Std-2525 Rev B
612            if (radii == null) {
613                //this call gets the radii and also stuffs H2
614                radii = clsUtility.GetRadii(tg, lineType);
615            }
616
617            int n = radii.length;
618
619            //loop thru the circles
620            POINT2[] pPoints = null;
621            for (l = 0; l < n; l++) {
622                radius = radii[l];
623                if (radius == 0) {
624                    continue;
625                }
626
627                pPoints = new POINT2[3];
628                pt = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
629                pPoints[0] = new POINT2(pt);
630                //radius, 90, ref lon2c, ref lat2c);
631                pt = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt, radius, 90);
632                pPoints[1] = new POINT2(pt);
633                pPoints[2] = new POINT2(pt);
634
635                pts = mdlGeodesic.GetGeodesicArc(pPoints);
636
637                POINT2 ptTemp2 = null;
638                //fill pixels and latlongs
639                int t = pts.size();
640                //for (j = 0; j < pts.size(); j++)//was 103
641                for (j = 0; j < t; j++)//was 103
642                {
643                    ptTemp2 = new POINT2();
644                    ptTemp2 = PointLatLongToPixels(pts.get(j), converter);
645                    ptTemp2.style = 0;
646                    if (j == pts.size() - 1) {
647                        ptTemp2.style = 5;
648                    }
649
650                    tg.Pixels.add(ptTemp2);
651                }
652            }
653            int length = tg.Pixels.size();
654            tg.Pixels.get(length - 1).style = 5;
655
656        } catch (Exception exc) {
657            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetConcentricCircles",
658                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetConcentricCircles", exc));
659        }
660    }

662    /**
663     * if tg.H2 is filled then the max range sector is used to determine the
664     * orientation
665     *
666     * @param tg
667     * @return left,right,min,max
668     */
669    private static String GetMaxSector(TGLight tg) {
670        String strLeftRightMinMax = null;
671        try {
672            double max = 0, maxx = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
673            //get the number of sectors
674            String H2 = tg.get_H2();
675            //H1 modifier is passed as left azimuth,right azimuth,min radius,max radius
676            String[] leftRightMinMax = H2.split(",");
677            int numSectors = leftRightMinMax.length / 4;
678            int k = 0, maxIndex = -1;
679            //there must be at least one sector
680            if (numSectors < 1) {
681                return null;
682            }
683
684            if (numSectors * 4 != leftRightMinMax.length) {
685                return null;
686            }
687            //get the max index
688            try {
689                for (k = 0; k < numSectors; k++) {
690                    //left = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k]);
691                    //right = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 1]);
692                    //min = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 2]);
693                    max = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 3]);
694                    if (max > maxx) {
695                        maxx = max;
696                        maxIndex = k;
697                    }
698                }
699            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
700                return null;
701            }
702            String strLeft = leftRightMinMax[4 * maxIndex];
703            String strRight = leftRightMinMax[4 * maxIndex + 1];
704            String strMin = leftRightMinMax[4 * maxIndex + 2];
705            String strMax = leftRightMinMax[4 * maxIndex + 3];
706            strLeftRightMinMax = strLeft + "," + strRight + "," + strMin + "," + strMax;
707        } catch (Exception exc) {
708            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetMaxSector",
709                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetMaxSector", exc));
710        }
711        return strLeftRightMinMax;
712    }

714    /**
715     * Create a tg with a new line type to used for circular range fan fill
716     *
717     * @param tg
718     * @return
719     */
720    protected static TGLight GetCircularRangeFanFillTG(TGLight tg) {
721        TGLight tg1 = null;
722        try {
723            //instantiate a dummy tg which will be used to call GetSectorRangeFan
724            tg1 = new TGLight();
725            tg1.set_VisibleModifiers(true);
726            tg1.set_LineThickness(0);
727            tg1.set_FillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
728            tg1.set_Fillstyle(tg.get_FillStyle());
729            tg1.LatLongs = new ArrayList<POINT2>();
730            tg1.Pixels = new ArrayList<POINT2>();
731            //we only want the 0th point
732            tg1.LatLongs.add(tg.LatLongs.get(0));
733            tg1.Pixels.add(tg.Pixels.get(0));
734            tg1.Pixels.add(tg.Pixels.get(1));
735            tg1.set_LineType(TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN_FILL);
736            String strH2 = tg.get_H2();
737
738            if (tg.get_LineType() != TacticalLines.RANGE_FAN) {
739                tg1.set_H2(strH2);
740                return tg1;
741            }
742
743            String[] H2 = strH2.split(",");
744            String leftRightMinMax = "";
745            int j = 0;
746            for (j = 0; j < H2.length - 1; j++) {
747                if (j > 0) {
748                    leftRightMinMax += ",";
749                }
750
751                leftRightMinMax += "0,0," + H2[j] + "," + H2[j + 1];
752            }
753            tg1.set_H2(leftRightMinMax);
754        } catch (Exception exc) {
755            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetCircularRangeFanFillTG",
756                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetCircularRangeFanFillTG", exc));
757        }
758        return tg1;
759    }

761    /**
762     *
763     * @param tg
764     * @param converter
765     * @return
766     */
767    private static boolean GetSectorRangeFan(TGLight tg, IPointConversion converter) {
768        boolean circle = false;
769        try {
770            POINT2 ptCenter = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
771            int k = 0, l = 0;
772            int numSectors = 0;
773            clsUtility.GetSectorRadiiFromPoints(tg);
774
775            //use pPoints to get each geodesic arc
776            ArrayList<POINT2> pPoints = new ArrayList();
777            ArrayList<POINT2> pPointsInnerArc = new ArrayList();
778            ArrayList<POINT2> pPointsOuterArc = new ArrayList();
779            ArrayList<POINT2> sectorPoints = new ArrayList();
780            ArrayList<POINT2> allPoints = new ArrayList();
781
782            //use these and the center to define each sector
783            POINT2 pt1 = new POINT2(), pt2 = new POINT2();
784
785            //get the number of sectors
786            String H2 = tg.get_H2();
787            //H1 modifier is passed as left azimuth,right azimuth,min radius,max radius
788            String[] leftRightMinMax = H2.split(",");
789
790            //sanity checks
791            double left = 0, right = 0, min = 0, max = 0;
792            numSectors = leftRightMinMax.length / 4;
793
794            //there must be at least one sector
795            if (numSectors < 1) {
796                return false;
797            }
798
799            if (numSectors * 4 != leftRightMinMax.length) {
800                return false;
801            }
802
803            //left must be  less than right,
804            //min must be less than max, each sector
805            try {
806                for (k = 0; k < numSectors; k++) {
807                    left = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k]);
808                    right = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 1]);
809                    min = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 2]);
810                    max = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 3]);
811                }
812            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
813                return false;
814            }
815
816            for (k = 0; k < numSectors; k++) //was k=0
817            {
818                //empty any points that were there from the last sector
819                sectorPoints.clear();
820                pPointsOuterArc.clear();
821                pPointsInnerArc.clear();
822
823                left = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k]);
824                right = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 1]);
825                min = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 2]);
826                max = Double.parseDouble(leftRightMinMax[4 * k + 3]);
827
828                //get the first point of the sector inner arc
829                pt1 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptCenter, min, left);
830
831                //get the last point of the sector inner arc
832                pt2 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptCenter, min, right);
833
834                pPoints.clear();
835
836                pPoints.add(ptCenter);
837                pPoints.add(pt1);
838                pPoints.add(pt2);
839
840                circle = mdlGeodesic.GetGeodesicArc2(pPoints, pPointsInnerArc);
841
842                pPoints.clear();
843                circle = false;
844
845                pt1 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptCenter, max, left);
846                pt2 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(ptCenter, max, right);
847
848                pPoints.add(ptCenter);
849                pPoints.add(pt1);
850                pPoints.add(pt2);
851
852                //get the geodesic min arc from left to right
853                circle = mdlGeodesic.GetGeodesicArc2(pPoints, pPointsOuterArc);
854
855                //we now have all the points and can add them to the polygon to return
856                //we will have to reverse the order of points in the outer arc
857                int n = pPointsInnerArc.size();
858                for (l = 0; l < n; l++) {
859                    pt1 = new POINT2(pPointsInnerArc.get(l));
860                    sectorPoints.add(pt1);
861                }
862                n = pPointsOuterArc.size();
863                //for (l = pPointsOuterArc.size() - 1; l >= 0; l--)
864                for (l = n - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
865                    pt1 = new POINT2(pPointsOuterArc.get(l));
866                    sectorPoints.add(pt1);
867                }
868
869                //close the polygon
870                pt1 = new POINT2(pPointsInnerArc.get(0));
871                pt1.style = 5;
872                sectorPoints.add(pt1);
873                n = sectorPoints.size();
874                //for (l = 0; l < sectorPoints.size(); l++)
875                for (l = 0; l < n; l++) {
876                    allPoints.add(sectorPoints.get(l));
877                }
878            }
879
880            //cleanup what we can
881            pPointsInnerArc = null;
882            pPointsOuterArc = null;
883            ptCenter = null;
884
885            POINT2 ptTemp = null;
886            int n = allPoints.size();
887            //for (l = 0; l < allPoints.size(); l++)
888            for (l = 0; l < n; l++) {
889                pt1 = new POINT2();
890                pt1 = PointLatLongToPixels(allPoints.get(l), converter);
891                //do not add duplicates
892                if (ptTemp != null && pt1.x == ptTemp.x && pt1.y == ptTemp.y) {
893                    continue;
894                }
895                tg.Pixels.add(new POINT2(pt1));
896                ptTemp = new POINT2(pt1);
897            }
898
899            return true;
900        } catch (Exception exc) {
901            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "GetSectorRangeFan",
902                    new RendererException("Failed inside GetSectorRangeFan", exc));
903        }
904        return circle;
905    }

907    private static void RangeFanOrientation(TGLight tg, int lineType, IPointConversion converter) {
908        try {
909            POINT2 pt0 = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
910            double dist = 0;
911            double orientation = 0;
912            double radius = 0;
913            //double[] radii = clsUtility.GetRadii(tg,lineType);
914            int j = 0;
915            POINT2 pt1 = new POINT2();
916            //if tg.PointCollection has more than one point
917            //we use pts[1] to stuff tg.H with the orientation
918            ref<double[]> a12 = new ref(), a21 = new ref();
919            if (tg.LatLongs.size() > 1) //rev B can use points
920            {
921                pt1 = tg.LatLongs.get(1);
922                dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(pt0, pt1, a12, a21);
923                orientation = a12.value[0];
924            } else //rev C uses H2
925            {
926                String strLeftRightMinMax = GetMaxSector(tg);
927                String[] sector = strLeftRightMinMax.split(",");
928                double left = Double.parseDouble(sector[0]);
929                double right = Double.parseDouble(sector[1]);
930                double min = Double.parseDouble(sector[2]);
931                double max = Double.parseDouble(sector[3]);
932                //we want the range to be 0 to 360
933                while (left > 360) {
934                    left -= 360;
935                }
936                while (right > 360) {
937                    right -= 360;
938                }
939                while (left < 0) {
940                    left += 360;
941                }
942                while (right < 0) {
943                    right += 360;
944                }
945
946                if (left > right) {
947                    orientation = (left - 360 + right) / 2;
948                } else {
949                    orientation = (left + right) / 2;
950                }
951
952                dist = max;
953            }
954            radius = dist * 1.1;
955            POINT2 pt0F = new POINT2();
956            POINT2 pt1F = new POINT2();
957            POINT2 ptBaseF = new POINT2();
958            POINT2 ptLeftF = new POINT2();
959            POINT2 ptRightF = new POINT2();
960            POINT2 ptTipF = new POINT2();
961
962            pt0 = tg.LatLongs.get(0);
963
964            pt0F = PointLatLongToPixels(pt0, converter);
965
966            pt1 = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, radius, orientation);
967
968            pt1F = PointLatLongToPixels(pt1, converter);
969            dist = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0F, pt1F);
970            double base = 10;
971            if (dist < 100) {
972                base = dist / 10;
973            }
974            if (base < 5) {
975                base = 5;
976            }
977            double basex2 = 2 * base;
978            ptBaseF = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt0F, pt1F, dist + base);   //was 10
979            ptTipF = lineutility.ExtendAlongLineDouble(pt0F, pt1F, dist + basex2);  //was 20
980
981            ptLeftF = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0F, ptBaseF, ptBaseF, 0, base);    //was 10
982            ptRightF = lineutility.ExtendDirectedLine(pt0F, ptBaseF, ptBaseF, 1, base);   //was 10
983            //length1 = tg.Pixels.size();
984
985            tg.Pixels.add(pt0F);
986            ptTipF.style = 5;
987            tg.Pixels.add(ptTipF);
988            tg.Pixels.add(ptLeftF);
989            ptTipF.style = 0;
990            tg.Pixels.add(ptTipF);
991            tg.Pixels.add(ptRightF);
992        } catch (Exception exc) {
993            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "RangeFanOrientation",
994                    new RendererException("Failed inside RangeFanOrientation", exc));
995        }
996    }

1040    /**
1041     * Filters too close points after segmenting and clipping
1042     *
1043     * @param tg
1044     * @param converter
1045     */
1046    protected static void FilterPoints2(TGLight tg, IPointConversion converter) {
1047        try {
1048            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
1049            double minSpikeDistance = 0;
1050            boolean segmented = true;
1051            if (tg.Pixels.size() < 3) {
1052                return;
1053            }
1054
1055            switch (lineType) {
1056                case TacticalLines.PL:
1057                case TacticalLines.LOA:
1058                case TacticalLines.LL:
1059                case TacticalLines.FCL:
1060                case TacticalLines.LOD:
1061                case TacticalLines.LDLC:
1062                case TacticalLines.PLD:
1063                case TacticalLines.HOLD:
1064                case TacticalLines.HOLD_GE:
1065                case TacticalLines.RELEASE:
1066                case TacticalLines.BRDGHD:
1067                case TacticalLines.BRDGHD_GE:
1068                case TacticalLines.NFL:
1069                    minSpikeDistance = 5;
1070                    segmented = false;
1071                    break;
1072                case TacticalLines.ATDITCH:
1073                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
1074                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
1075                case TacticalLines.FLOT:
1076                case TacticalLines.FORT:
1077                case TacticalLines.FORTL:
1078                case TacticalLines.STRONG:
1079                    minSpikeDistance = 25;
1080                    break;
1081                case TacticalLines.LC:
1082                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
1083                case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
1084                case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
1085                case TacticalLines.BELT:    //belt as an area
1086                case TacticalLines.BELT1:   //belt as a line (USAS)
1087                case TacticalLines.ZONE:
1088                case TacticalLines.LINE:
1089                case TacticalLines.ATWALL:
1090                //case TacticalLines.ATWALL3D:
1091                case TacticalLines.UNSP:
1092                case TacticalLines.SFENCE:
1093                case TacticalLines.DFENCE:
1094                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEA:
1095                case TacticalLines.LWFENCE:
1096                case TacticalLines.HWFENCE:
1097                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC:
1098                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEC:
1099                case TacticalLines.TRIPLE:
1100                    minSpikeDistance = 35;
1101                    break;
1102                case TacticalLines.ICE_EDGE_RADAR:  //METOCs
1103                case TacticalLines.ICE_OPENINGS_FROZEN:
1104                case TacticalLines.CRACKS_SPECIFIC_LOCATION:
1105                    minSpikeDistance = 35;
1106                    break;
1107                default:
1108                    return;
1109            }
1110            double dist = 0;
1111
1112            ArrayList<POINT2> pts = new ArrayList();
1113
1114            //stuff pts with tg.Pixels
1115            //loop through pts to remove any points which are too close
1116            //then reset tg.Pixels with the new array with boundary points removed,            
1117            int j = 0;
1118            POINT2 pt = null, pt0 = null, pt1 = null;
1119            int n = tg.Pixels.size();
1120            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
1121            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
1122                pt = tg.Pixels.get(j);
1123                pt.style = tg.Pixels.get(j).style;
1124                pts.add(pt);
1125            }
1126
1127            boolean removedPt = true;
1128            //order of priority is: keep anchor points, then boundary points, then segmented points
1129            outer:
1130            while (removedPt == true) {
1131                removedPt = false;
1132                //n=pts.size();
1133                for (j = 0; j < pts.size() - 1; j++) {
1134                    pt0 = pts.get(j);
1135                    pt1 = pts.get(j + 1);
1136                    dist = lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pts.get(j), pts.get(j + 1));
1137                    if (dist < minSpikeDistance) {
1138                        if (segmented == false) {
1139                            if (j + 1 == pts.size() - 1) {
1140                                pts.remove(j);
1141                            } else {
1142                                pts.remove(j + 1);
1143                            }
1144
1145                            removedPt = true;
1146                            break outer;
1147                        } else if (pt0.style == 0 && pt1.style == -1)//-1 are clipped boundary points
1148                        {
1149                            pts.remove(j + 1);
1150                            removedPt = true;
1151                            break outer;
1152                        } else if (pt0.style == 0 && pt1.style == -2)//-2 are segmented points, this should never happen
1153                        {
1154                            pts.remove(j + 1);
1155                            removedPt = true;
1156                            break outer;
1157                        } else if (pt0.style == -1 && pt1.style == 0) {
1158                            pts.remove(j);
1159                            removedPt = true;
1160                            break outer;
1161                        } else if (pt0.style == -1 && pt1.style == -1) {
1162                            pts.remove(j + 1);
1163                            removedPt = true;
1164                            break outer;
1165                        } else if (pt0.style == -1 && pt1.style == -2) {
1166                            pts.remove(j + 1);
1167                            removedPt = true;
1168                            break outer;
1169                        } else if (pt0.style == -2 && pt1.style == 0)//this should never happen
1170                        {
1171                            pts.remove(j);
1172                            removedPt = true;
1173                            break outer;
1174                        } else if (pt0.style == -2 && pt1.style == -1) {
1175                            pts.remove(j);
1176                            removedPt = true;
1177                            break outer;
1178                        } else if (pt0.style == -2 && pt1.style == -2) {
1179                            pts.remove(j + 1);
1180                            removedPt = true;
1181                            break outer;
1182                        }
1183                    }
1184                    //n=pts.size();
1185                }
1186            }
1187            tg.Pixels = pts;
1188            tg.LatLongs = armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.PixelsToLatLong(pts, converter);
1189
1190        } catch (Exception exc) {
1191            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "FilterPoints2",
1192                    new RendererException("Failed inside FilterPoints2", exc));
1193
1194        }
1195    }

1414            case TacticalLines.DFENCE:

1429            case TacticalLines.MSR:
1430            case TacticalLines.ASR:
1431            case TacticalLines.ONEWAY:
1432            case TacticalLines.TWOWAY:
1433            case TacticalLines.ALT:
1434                //undo any fill
1435                Shape2 shape = null;
1436                if (shapes != null && shapes.size() > 0) {
1437                    int n = shapes.size();
1438                    //for(int j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
1439                    for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {

1442                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
1443                        }
1444                    }
1445                }
1446                return true;
1447            default:
1448                return false;

1450        }

1461    protected static ArrayList<POINT2> Point2DtoPOINT2Mapped(ArrayList<Point2D> pts2d, Map<String, Object> hashMap) {

1464            Point2D pt2d;

1480                    new RendererException("Failed inside Point2DToPOINT2Mapped", exc));

1482        return pts;

1516    /**
1517     * Builds a single shape from a point array. Currently we assume the array
1518     * represents a moveTo followed by a series of lineTo operations

1521     * @return
1522     */
1523    private static Shape BuildShapeFromPoints(ArrayList<Point2D> pts2d) {
1524        GeneralPath shape = new GeneralPath();
1525        try {
1526            shape.moveTo(pts2d.get(0).getX(), pts2d.get(0).getY());

1531            }
1532        } catch (Exception exc) {
1533            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "buildShapeFromPoints",
1534                    new RendererException("Failed inside buildShapeFromPoints", exc));
1535
1536        }
1537        return shape;
1538    }

1540    /**
1541     * Clips a ShapeSpec. Assumes we are not post clipping splines, therefore
1542     * all the operations are moveTo, lineTo. Each ShapeSpec is assumed to be:
1543     * moveTo, lineTo ... lineTo, followed by another moveTo, lineTo, ...
1544     * lineTo, followed by ...
1545     *
1546     * @param shapeSpec
1547     * @param pts
1548     * @param clipArea
1549     * @return a single clipped shapeSpec
1550     */
1551    protected static ArrayList<Shape2> buildShapeSpecFromPoints(TGLight tg0,
1552            Shape2 shapeSpec, //the original ShapeSpec
1553            ArrayList<POINT2> pts,
1554            Object clipArea) {
1555        ArrayList<Shape2> shapeSpecs2 = null;
1556        Shape2 shapeSpec2;
1557        try {
1558            //create a tg to use for the clip
1559            shapeSpecs2 = new ArrayList();
1560            int j = 0, n = 0;
1561            //return null if it is outside the bounds
1562            Rectangle rect = shapeSpec.getBounds();
1563            int h = shapeSpec.getBounds().height;
1564            int w = shapeSpec.getBounds().width;
1565            int x = shapeSpec.getBounds().x;
1566            int y = shapeSpec.getBounds().y;
1567//            if(h==0 && w==0)
1568//                return shapeSpecs2;
1569
1570            if (h == 0) {
1571                h = 1;
1572            }
1573            if (w == 0) {
1574                w = 1;
1575            }
1576
1577            Rectangle2D clipBounds = null;
1578            ArrayList<Point2D> clipPoints = null;
1579            if (clipArea != null && clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class)) {
1580                clipBounds = (Rectangle2D) clipArea;
1581            } else if (clipArea != null && clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class)) {
1582                //clipBounds=(Rectangle2D)clipArea;
1583                Rectangle rectx = (Rectangle) clipArea;
1584                clipBounds = new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x, rectx.y, rectx.width, rectx.height);
1585            } else if (clipArea != null && clipArea.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class)) {
1586                clipPoints = (ArrayList<Point2D>) clipArea;
1587            }
1588
1589            if (clipBounds != null && clipBounds.contains(shapeSpec.getShape().getBounds2D()) == false
1590                    && clipBounds.intersects(shapeSpec.getShape().getBounds2D()) == false) {
1591                //this tests if the shape has height or width 0
1592                //but may be contained within the clipbounds or intersect it
1593                //in that case we gave it a default width or thickness of 1
1594                if (clipBounds.contains(x, y, w, h) == false
1595                        && clipBounds.intersects(x, y, w, h) == false) {
1596                    return shapeSpecs2;
1597                }
1598            } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1599                GeneralPath poly = new GeneralPath();
1600                n = clipPoints.size();
1601                //for(j=0;j<clipPoints.size();j++)
1602                for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
1603                    if (j == 0) {
1604                        poly.moveTo(clipPoints.get(j).getX(), clipPoints.get(j).getY());
1605                    } else {
1606                        poly.lineTo(clipPoints.get(j).getX(), clipPoints.get(j).getY());
1607                    }
1608                }
1609                poly.closePath();
1610                if (poly.contains(shapeSpec.getShape().getBounds2D()) == false
1611                        && poly.intersects(shapeSpec.getShape().getBounds2D()) == false) {
1612                    if (poly.contains(x, y, w, h) == false
1613                            && poly.intersects(x, y, w, h) == false) {
1614                        return shapeSpecs2;
1615                    }
1616                }
1617            }
1618
1619            if (shapeSpec.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_MODIFIER
1620                    || shapeSpec.getShapeType() == Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_MODIFIER_FILL) {
1621                shapeSpecs2.add(shapeSpec);
1622                return shapeSpecs2;
1623            }
1624            TGLight tg = new TGLight();
1625            POINT2 pt = null;
1626            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.PL);
1627            ArrayList<POINT2> pts2 = new ArrayList();
1628            ArrayList<Point2D> pts2d = null;
1629            Shape shape = null;
1630            GeneralPath gp = new GeneralPath();
1631            //loop through the points
1632            n = pts.size();
1633            //for(j=0;j<pts.size();j++)
1634            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
1635                pt = pts.get(j);
1636                //new line
1637                switch (pt.style) {
1638                    case 0: //moveTo,
1639                        //they lifted the pencil, so we build the shape from the existing pts and append it
1640                        if (pts2.size() > 1) {
1641                            //clip the points
1642                            tg = new TGLight();
1643                            tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.PL);
1644                            tg.Pixels = pts2;
1645                            if (clipBounds != null) {
1646                                pts2d = clsClipPolygon2.ClipPolygon(tg, clipBounds);
1647                            } else if (clipPoints != null && !clipPoints.isEmpty()) {
1648                                pts2d = clsClipQuad.ClipPolygon(tg, clipPoints);
1649                            }
1650
1651                            //build a GeneralPath from the points we collected, we will append it
1652                            if (pts2d != null && pts2d.size() > 1) {
1653                                shape = BuildShapeFromPoints(pts2d);
1654                                //append the shape because we want to return only one shape
1655                                gp.append(shape, false);
1656                            }
1657                            //clear the points array and begin the next line
1658                            pts2.clear();
1659                            pts2.add(pt);
1660                        } else {
1661                            pts2.add(pt);
1662                        }
1663                        break;
1664                    case 1: //lineTo
1665                        pts2.add(pt);
1666                        break;
1667                    default:
1668                        pts2.add(pt);
1669                        break;
1670                }
1671            }//end for
1672            //append the last shape
1673            if (pts2.size() > 1) {
1674                //clip the points
1675                tg = new TGLight();
1676                tg.set_LineType(TacticalLines.PL);
1677                tg.Pixels = pts2;
1678                if (clipBounds != null) {
1679                    pts2d = clsClipPolygon2.ClipPolygon(tg, clipBounds);
1680                } else if (clipPoints != null) {
1681                    pts2d = clsClipQuad.ClipPolygon(tg, clipPoints);
1682                }
1683                //build a GeneralPath from the points we collected, we will append it
1684                if (pts2d != null && pts2d.size() > 1) {
1685                    shape = BuildShapeFromPoints(pts2d);
1686                    gp.append(shape, false);
1687                }
1688                tg0.set_WasClipped(tg.get_WasClipped());
1689            }
1690            //create the shapespec here
1691            //initialize the clipped ShapeSpec
1692            shapeSpec2 = new Shape2(shapeSpec.getShapeType());
1693            shapeSpec2.setLineColor(shapeSpec.getLineColor());
1694            shapeSpec2.setFillColor(shapeSpec.getFillColor());
1695            shapeSpec2.setStroke(shapeSpec.getStroke());
1696            shapeSpec2.setTexturePaint(shapeSpec.getTexturePaint());
1697            shapeSpec2.setShape(gp);
1698            shapeSpecs2.add(shapeSpec2);
1699        } catch (Exception exc) {
1700            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "buildShapeSpecFromPoints",
1701                    new RendererException("Failed inside buildShapeSpecFromPoints", exc));
1702
1703        }
1704        return shapeSpecs2;
1705    }
1706
1707    /**
1708     * Currently assumes no MeTOC symbols are post clipped
1709     *
1710     * @param shapeSpecs
1711     * @param clipBounds
1712     * @return
1713     */
1714    protected static ArrayList<Shape2> postClipShapes(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2> shapeSpecsArray, Object clipArea) {
1715        ArrayList<Shape2> shapeSpecs2 = null;
1716        ArrayList<Shape2> tempShapes = null;
1717        try {
1718            if (shapeSpecsArray == null || shapeSpecsArray.size() == 0) {
1719                return null;
1720            }
1721
1722            shapeSpecs2 = new ArrayList();
1723            int j = 0;
1724            ArrayList<Shape2> shapeSpecs = new ArrayList();
1725            int n = shapeSpecsArray.size();
1726            //for(j=0;j<shapeSpecsArray.size();j++)
1727            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
1728                shapeSpecs.add(shapeSpecsArray.get(j));
1729            }
1730
1731            ArrayList<POINT2> pts = new ArrayList();//use these
1732            Shape shape = null;
1733            POINT2 pt;
1734            float[] coords = new float[6];
1735            Shape2 shapeSpec = null;
1736            n = shapeSpecs.size();
1737            //for(j=0;j<shapeSpecs.size();j++)
1738            for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
1739                shapeSpec = shapeSpecs.get(j);
1740                shape = shapeSpec.getShape();
1741                pts.clear();
1742                for (PathIterator i = shape.getPathIterator(null); !i.isDone(); i.next()) {
1743                    int type = i.currentSegment(coords);
1744                    switch (type) {
1745                        case PathIterator.SEG_MOVETO:
1746                            pt = new POINT2(coords[0], coords[1]);
1747                            pt.style = 0;
1748                            pts.add(pt);
1749                            break;
1750                        case PathIterator.SEG_LINETO:
1751                            pt = new POINT2(coords[0], coords[1]);
1752                            pt.style = 1;
1753                            pts.add(pt);
1754                            break;
1755                        case PathIterator.SEG_QUADTO:   //not using this
1756                            pt = new POINT2(coords[0], coords[1]);
1757                            pt.style = 2;
1758                            pts.add(pt);
1759                            pt = new POINT2(coords[2], coords[3]);
1760                            pt.style = 2;
1761                            pts.add(pt);
1762                            break;
1763                        case PathIterator.SEG_CUBICTO:  //not using this
1764                            pt = new POINT2(coords[0], coords[1]);
1765                            pt.style = 3;
1766                            pts.add(pt);
1767                            pt = new POINT2(coords[2], coords[3]);
1768                            pt.style = 3;
1769                            pts.add(pt);
1770                            pt = new POINT2(coords[4], coords[5]);
1771                            pt.style = 3;
1772                            pts.add(pt);
1773                            break;
1774                        case PathIterator.SEG_CLOSE://not using this
1775                            pt = new POINT2(coords[0], coords[1]);
1776                            pt.style = 4;
1777                            pts.add(pt);
1778                            break;
1779                        default:
1780                            pt = null;
1781                            break;
1782                    }//end switch
1783                }   //end for pathiterator i
1784                tempShapes = buildShapeSpecFromPoints(tg, shapeSpec, pts, clipArea);
1785                shapeSpecs2.addAll(tempShapes);
1786            }
1787        } catch (Exception exc) {
1788            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "postClipShapes",
1789                    new RendererException("Failed inside postClipShapes", exc));
1790        }
1791        return shapeSpecs2;
1792    }

1794    /**
1795     * For the 3d map we cannot pre-segment the auto-shapes or fire support
1796     * areas. We do need to pre-segment generic lines regardless of the status
1797     * if clipping is set. Currently we are not pre-segmenting axis of advance
1798     * symbols.
1799     *
1800     * @param tg
1801     * @return true if pre-segmenting is to be used
1802     */
1803    private static boolean segmentAnticipatedLine(TGLight tg) {
1804        try {
1805            int linetype = tg.get_LineType();
1806            //do not pre-segment the fire support rectangular and circular areas
1807            if (clsUtility.IsChange1Area(linetype, null)) {
1808                return false;
1809            }
1810            //do not pre-segment the autoshapes
1811            if (armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.isAutoshape(tg)) {
1812                return false;
1813            }
1814            if (clsUtility.isBasicShape(linetype)) {
1815                return false;
1816            }
1817            //temporarily do not pre-segment the channel types.
1818            switch (linetype) {
1819                case TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE:
1820                case TacticalLines.OVERHEAD_WIRE_LS:
1821                case TacticalLines.FEBA:
1822                case TacticalLines.CATK:
1823                case TacticalLines.CATKBYFIRE:
1824                case TacticalLines.AAFNT:
1825                case TacticalLines.AXAD:
1826                case TacticalLines.MAIN:
1827                case TacticalLines.SPT:
1828                case TacticalLines.AIRAOA:
1829                case TacticalLines.AAAAA:
1830                    return false;
1831                case TacticalLines.TWOWAY:
1832                case TacticalLines.ONEWAY:
1833                case TacticalLines.ALT:
1834                    //added because of segment data 4-22-13
1835                    //removed from this case block since we now post-clip these because of segment color data 10-5-16
1836//                case TacticalLines.MSR:
1837//                case TacticalLines.ASR:
1838//                case TacticalLines.BOUNDARY:
1839                    return false;
1840                default:
1841                    break;
1842            }
1843
1844        } catch (Exception exc) {
1845            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "segmentGenericLine",
1846                    new RendererException("Failed inside segmentGenericLine", exc));
1847        }
1848        return true;
1849    }

1851    /**
1852     * cannot pre-segment the fire support areas, must post segment them after
1853     * the pixels were calculated
1854     *
1855     * @param tg
1856     * @param converter
1857     */
1858    protected static void postSegmentFSA(TGLight tg,
1859            IPointConversion converter) {
1860        try {
1861            if (tg.get_Client().equals("2D")) {
1862                return;
1863            }
1864
1865            int linetype = tg.get_LineType();
1866            switch (linetype) {
1867                case TacticalLines.PAA_RECTANGULAR_REVC:
1868                case TacticalLines.FSA_RECTANGULAR:
1869                case TacticalLines.FFA_RECTANGULAR:
1870                case TacticalLines.ACA_RECTANGULAR:
1871                case TacticalLines.NFA_RECTANGULAR:
1872                case TacticalLines.RFA_RECTANGULAR:
1873                case TacticalLines.ATI_RECTANGULAR:
1874                case TacticalLines.CFFZ_RECTANGULAR:
1875                case TacticalLines.SENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
1876                case TacticalLines.CENSOR_RECTANGULAR:
1877                case TacticalLines.DA_RECTANGULAR:
1878                case TacticalLines.CFZ_RECTANGULAR:
1879                case TacticalLines.ZOR_RECTANGULAR:
1880                case TacticalLines.TBA_RECTANGULAR:
1881                case TacticalLines.TVAR_RECTANGULAR:
1882                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXBLUE_RECTANGULAR:
1883                case TacticalLines.KILLBOXPURPLE_RECTANGULAR:
1884                    break;
1885                default:
1886                    return;
1887            }
1888            ArrayList<POINT2> latLongs = new ArrayList();
1889            ArrayList<POINT2> resultPts = new ArrayList();
1890            int j = 0, k = 0, n = 0;
1891            POINT2 pt0 = null, pt1 = null, pt = null;
1892            double dist = 0;
1893            //double interval=1000000;
1894            double interval = 250000;
1895            double az = 0;
1896
1897            double maxDist = 0;
1898            Point2D pt2d = null;
1899            int t = tg.Pixels.size();
1900            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
1901            for (j = 0; j < t; j++) {
1902                pt0 = tg.Pixels.get(j);
1903                pt2d = new Point2D.Double(pt0.x, pt0.y);
1904                pt2d = converter.PixelsToGeo(pt2d);
1905                pt0 = new POINT2(pt2d.getX(), pt2d.getY());
1906                latLongs.add(pt0);
1907            }
1908            t = latLongs.size();
1909            //for(j=0;j<latLongs.size()-1;j++)
1910            for (j = 0; j < t - 1; j++) {
1911                pt0 = latLongs.get(j);
1912                pt1 = latLongs.get(j + 1);
1913                pt1.style = -1;//end point
1914                az = mdlGeodesic.GetAzimuth(pt0, pt1);
1915                dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(latLongs.get(j), latLongs.get(j + 1), null, null);
1916                if (dist > maxDist) {
1917                    maxDist = dist;
1918                }
1919            }
1920
1921            if (interval > maxDist) {
1922                interval = maxDist;
1923            }
1924
1925            //for(j=0;j<latLongs.size()-1;j++)
1926            for (j = 0; j < t - 1; j++) {
1927                pt0 = new POINT2(latLongs.get(j));
1928                pt0.style = 0;//anchor point
1929                pt1 = new POINT2(latLongs.get(j + 1));
1930                pt1.style = 0;//anchor point point
1931                az = mdlGeodesic.GetAzimuth(pt0, pt1);
1932                dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(latLongs.get(j), latLongs.get(j + 1), null, null);
1933
1934                n = (int) (dist / interval);
1935                if (j == 0) {
1936                    resultPts.add(pt0);
1937                }
1938
1939                for (k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
1940                    pt = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, interval * k, az);
1941                    pt.style = -2;
1942                    //we do not want the last segment to be too close to the anchor point
1943                    //only add the segment point if it is a distance at least half the inteval
1944                    //from the 2nd anchor point
1945                    dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(pt, pt1, null, null);
1946                    if (dist >= interval / 2) {
1947                        resultPts.add(pt);
1948                    }
1949                }
1950                //ad the 2nd anchor point
1951                resultPts.add(pt1);
1952            }
1953            latLongs = resultPts;
1954            tg.Pixels = armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(latLongs, converter);
1955        } catch (Exception exc) {
1956            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "postSegmentFSA",
1957                    new RendererException("Failed inside postSegmentFSA", exc));
1958        }
1959    }

1961    /**
1962     * Similar to Vincenty algorithm for more accurate interpolation of geo
1963     * anchor points
1964     *
1965     * @param points the anchor points
1966     * @param n number of points per segment
1967     * @return the interpolated points
1968     */
1969    private static ArrayList<POINT2> toGeodesic(TGLight tg, double interval, HashMap hmap) {
1970        ArrayList<POINT2> locs = new ArrayList<POINT2>();
1971        try {
1972            int i = 0, k = 0, n = 0;
1973            ArrayList<POINT2> points = tg.LatLongs;
1974            String H = "";
1975            String color = "";
1976            boolean bolIsAC = false;
1977            int acWidth = 0;
1978            int linetype = tg.get_LineType();
1979            switch (linetype) {
1980                case TacticalLines.MRR_USAS:
1981                case TacticalLines.UAV_USAS:
1982                case TacticalLines.AC:
1983                case TacticalLines.LLTR:
1984                case TacticalLines.SAAFR:
1985                    bolIsAC = true;
1986                    break;
1987                default:
1988                    break;
1989            }
1990            for (i = 0; i < points.size() - 1; i++) {
1991                if(bolIsAC)
1992                    acWidth=points.get(i).style;
1993                // Convert coordinates from degrees to Radians
1994                //var lat1 = points[i].latitude * (PI / 180);
1995                //var lon1 = points[i].longitude * (PI / 180);
1996                //var lat2 = points[i + 1].latitude * (PI / 180);
1997                //var lon2 = points[i + 1].longitude * (PI / 180);                
1998                double lat1 = Math.toRadians(points.get(i).y);
1999                double lon1 = Math.toRadians(points.get(i).x);
2000                double lat2 = Math.toRadians(points.get(i + 1).y);
2001                double lon2 = Math.toRadians(points.get(i + 1).x);
2002                // Calculate the total extent of the route
2003                //var d = 2 * asin(sqrt(pow((sin((lat1 - lat2) / 2)), 2) + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * pow((sin((lon1 - lon2) / 2)), 2)));
2004                double d = 2 * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(Math.pow((Math.sin((lat1 - lat2) / 2)), 2) + Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.pow((Math.sin((lon1 - lon2) / 2)), 2)));
2005
2006                double dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(points.get(i), points.get(i + 1), null, null);
2007                //double dist=d;
2008                float flt = (float) dist / (float) interval;
2009                n = Math.round(flt);
2010                if (n < 1) {
2011                    n = 1;
2012                }
2013                if (n > 32) {
2014                    n = 32;
2015                }
2016                // Calculate  positions at fixed intervals along the route
2017                for (k = 0; k <= n; k++) {
2018                    //we must preserve the anchor points
2019                    if (k == 0) {
2020                        locs.add(new POINT2(points.get(i)));
2021                        if (hmap != null && hmap.containsKey(i)) {
2022                            if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2023                                H += ",";
2024                            }
2025                            color = (String) hmap.get(i);
2026                            H += Integer.toString(locs.size() - 1) + ":" + color;
2027                        }
2028                        continue;
2029                    } else if (k == n) {
2030                        if (i == points.size() - 2) {
2031                            locs.add(new POINT2(points.get(i + 1)));
2032                            if (hmap != null && hmap.containsKey(i + 1)) {
2033                                if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2034                                    H += ",";
2035                                }
2036                                color = (String) hmap.get(i + 1);
2037                                H += Integer.toString(locs.size() - 1) + ":" + color;
2038                            }
2039                        }
2040                        break;
2041                    }
2042                    //var f = (k / n);
2043                    //var A = sin((1 - f) * d) / sin(d);
2044                    //var B = sin(f * d) / sin(d);
2045                    double f = ((double) k / (double) n);
2046                    double A = Math.sin((1 - f) * d) / Math.sin(d);
2047                    double B = Math.sin(f * d) / Math.sin(d);
2048                    // Obtain 3D Cartesian coordinates of each point
2049                    //var x = A * cos(lat1) * cos(lon1) + B * cos(lat2) * cos(lon2);
2050                    //var y = A * cos(lat1) * sin(lon1) + B * cos(lat2) * sin(lon2);
2051                    //var z = A * sin(lat1) + B * sin(lat2);
2052                    double x = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.cos(lon2);
2053                    double y = A * Math.cos(lat1) * Math.sin(lon1) + B * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(lon2);
2054                    double z = A * Math.sin(lat1) + B * Math.sin(lat2);
2055                    // Convert these to latitude/longitude
2056                    //var lat = atan2(z, sqrt(pow(x, 2) + pow(y, 2)));
2057                    //var lon = atan2(y, x);
2058                    double lat = Math.atan2(z, Math.sqrt(Math.pow(x, 2) + Math.pow(y, 2)));
2059                    double lon = Math.atan2(y, x);
2060                    lat *= 180.0 / Math.PI;
2061                    lon *= 180.0 / Math.PI;
2062                    POINT2 pt = new POINT2(lon, lat);
2063                    if(bolIsAC)
2064                        pt.style=-acWidth;
2065                    locs.add(pt);
2066                    if (hmap != null && hmap.containsKey(i)) {
2067                        if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2068                            H += ",";
2069                        }
2070                        color = (String) hmap.get(i);
2071                        H += Integer.toString(locs.size() - 1) + ":" + color;
2072                    }
2073                }
2074            }
2075            if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2076                tg.set_H(H);
2077            }
2078        } catch (Exception exc) {
2079            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "toGeodesic",
2080                    new RendererException("Failed inside toGeodesic", exc));
2081            return null;
2082        }
2083        return locs;
2084    }
