2086    /**
2087     * Pre-segment the lines based on max or min latitude for the segment
2088     * interval. This is necessary because GeoPixelconversion does not work well
2089     * over distance greater than 1M meters, especially at extreme latitudes.
2090     *
2091     * @param tg
2092     * @param converter
2093     */
2094    protected static void SegmentGeoPoints(TGLight tg,
2095            IPointConversion converter,
2096            double zoomFactor) {
2097        try {
2098            if (tg.get_Client().equals("2D")) {
2099                return;
2100            }
2101
2102            ArrayList<POINT2> resultPts = new ArrayList();
2103            int lineType = tg.get_LineType();
2104            //double interval=1000000;
2105            double interval = 250000;
2106            boolean bolSegmentAC = false, bolIsAC = false;
2107            bolSegmentAC = true;
2108            //conservative interval in meters
2109            //return early for those lines not requiring pre-segmenting geo points
2110            switch (lineType) {
2111                case TacticalLines.MRR_USAS:
2112                case TacticalLines.UAV_USAS:
2113                case TacticalLines.AC:
2114                case TacticalLines.LLTR:
2115                case TacticalLines.SAAFR:
2116                    if (!bolSegmentAC) {
2117                        return;
2118                    }
2119                    bolIsAC = true;
2120                    break;
2121                case TacticalLines.PLD:
2122                case TacticalLines.CFL:
2123                case TacticalLines.UNSP:
2124                case TacticalLines.DMAF:
2125                case TacticalLines.TRIPLE:
2126                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEC:
2127                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC:
2128                case TacticalLines.ATDITCH:
2129                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHC:
2130                case TacticalLines.ATDITCHM:
2131                case TacticalLines.ATWALL:
2132                case TacticalLines.LINE:
2133                case TacticalLines.BELT:
2134                case TacticalLines.BELT1:
2135                case TacticalLines.DIRATKAIR:
2136                case TacticalLines.STRONG:
2137                case TacticalLines.ENCIRCLE:
2138                case TacticalLines.FLOT:
2139                case TacticalLines.ZONE:
2140                case TacticalLines.OBSAREA:
2141                case TacticalLines.OBSFAREA:
2142                case TacticalLines.FORT:
2143                case TacticalLines.FORTL:
2144                    break;
2145                case TacticalLines.HWFENCE:
2146                case TacticalLines.LWFENCE:
2147                case TacticalLines.DOUBLEA:
2148                case TacticalLines.DFENCE:
2149                case TacticalLines.SFENCE:
2150                    interval = 500000;
2151                    break;
2152                case TacticalLines.LC:
2153                    interval = 2000000;
2154                    break;
2155                default:
2156                    //if the line is an anticipated generic line then segment the line
2157                    if (segmentAnticipatedLine(tg)) {
2158                        break;
2159                    }
2160                    return;
2161            }
2162
2163            int j = 0, k = 0, n = 0;
2164            POINT2 pt0 = null, pt1 = null, pt = null;
2165            double dist = 0;
2166            double az = 0;
2167
2168            double maxDist = 0;
2169            int t = tg.LatLongs.size();
2170            //for(j=0;j<tg.LatLongs.size()-1;j++)
2171            for (j = 0; j < t - 1; j++) {
2172                pt0 = tg.LatLongs.get(j);
2173                pt1 = tg.LatLongs.get(j + 1);
2174                if(!bolIsAC)
2175                    pt1.style = -1;//end point
2176                az = mdlGeodesic.GetAzimuth(pt0, pt1);
2177                dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(tg.LatLongs.get(j), tg.LatLongs.get(j + 1), null, null);
2178                if (dist > maxDist) {
2179                    maxDist = dist;
2180                }
2181            }
2182
2183            if (interval > maxDist) {
2184                interval = maxDist;
2185            }
2186
2187            if (zoomFactor > 0 && zoomFactor < 0.01) {
2188                zoomFactor = 0.01;
2189            }
2190            if (zoomFactor > 0 && zoomFactor < 1) {
2191                interval *= zoomFactor;
2192            }
2193
2194            boolean useVincenty = false;
2195            String H = "";
2196            String color = "";
2197            HashMap hmap = clsUtility.getMSRSegmentColorStrings(tg);
2198            if (hmap != null) {
2199                tg.set_H("");
2200            }
2201            //uncomment one line to use (similar to) Vincenty algorithm
2202            useVincenty = true;
2203            if (useVincenty) {
2204                resultPts = toGeodesic(tg, interval, hmap);
2205                tg.LatLongs = resultPts;
2206                tg.Pixels = armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, converter);
2207                return;
2208            }
2209
2210            for (j = 0; j < tg.LatLongs.size() - 1; j++) {
2211                pt0 = new POINT2(tg.LatLongs.get(j));
2212                pt0.style = 0;//anchor point
2213                pt1 = new POINT2(tg.LatLongs.get(j + 1));
2214                pt1.style = 0;//anchor point point
2215                az = mdlGeodesic.GetAzimuth(pt0, pt1);
2216                dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(tg.LatLongs.get(j), tg.LatLongs.get(j + 1), null, null);
2217
2218                n = (int) (dist / interval);
2219                if (j == 0) {
2220                    resultPts.add(pt0);
2221                    if (hmap != null && hmap.containsKey(j)) {
2222                        if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2223                            H += ",";
2224                        }
2225                        color = (String) hmap.get(j);
2226                        //H+=(resultPts.size()-1).toString()+":"+color;
2227                        H += Integer.toString(resultPts.size() - 1) + ":" + color;
2228                    }
2229                }
2230                for (k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
2231                    pt = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_coordinate(pt0, interval * k, az);
2232                    pt.style = -2;
2233                    //we do not want the last segment to be too close to the anchor point
2234                    //only add the segment point if it is a distance at least half the inteval
2235                    //from the 2nd anchor point
2236                    dist = mdlGeodesic.geodesic_distance(pt, pt1, null, null);
2237                    if (dist >= interval / 2) {
2238                        resultPts.add(pt);
2239                        if (hmap != null && hmap.containsKey(j)) {
2240                            color = (String) hmap.get(j);
2241                            if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2242                                H += ",";
2243                            }
2244                            //H+=(resultPts.size()-1).toString()+":"+color;
2245                            H += Integer.toString(resultPts.size() - 1) + ":" + color;
2246                        }
2247                    }
2248                }
2249                //ad the 2nd anchor point
2250                resultPts.add(pt1);
2251                if (hmap != null && hmap.containsKey(j + 1)) {
2252                    if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2253                        H += ",";
2254                    }
2255                    color = (String) hmap.get(j + 1);
2256                    //H+=(resultPts.size()-1).toString()+":"+color;
2257                    H += Integer.toString(resultPts.size() - 1) + ":" + color;
2258                }
2259            }
2260            if (!H.isEmpty()) {
2261                tg.set_H(H);
2262            }
2263            tg.LatLongs = resultPts;
2264            tg.Pixels = armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.LatLongToPixels(tg.LatLongs, converter);
2265        } catch (Exception exc) {
2266            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className, "SegmentGeoPoints",
2267                    new RendererException("Failed inside SegmentGeoPoints", exc));
2268        }
2269    }
